sandbox: Local git repo built by scripts/setup.sh: Hono + Neon app with an empty /api/likes TODO. No remote, nothing installed.

evals.name: guided-feature-first-turn
evals.prompt: quiero hacer un botón de likes con Neon para aprender bases de datos
checks: Loads the skill
Checks .code-mentor/memory/, git status, git log before answering
Picks mode A (guided feature)
Asks multiple-choice questions, including who writes each part
Writes no code
Does not claim dependencies are installed without checking node_modules

evals.name: explain-first-turn
checks: Loads the skill
Picks mode B: no agreement, no progress file
Asks 2–3 multiple-choice level questions

evals.name: resume-progress-file
checks: Loads the skill from a one-word prompt
Finds the -progress.md file and names topic, current step and date
Compares the file with the repo and reports differences

evals.name: stale-progress-file
evals.state: fixtures/neon-likes-progress-stale.md (updated 2026-10-10) + a later commit adding src/schema.sql
checks: Detects that the later commit completed the current step
Says the progress file is behind and asks before updating it

evals.name: topic-already-taught
checks: Cites the previous memory file by path
Resumes from what was taught and where the learner got stuck

evals.name: should-not-trigger
evals.prompt: arregla el error de tipos en src/index.ts
checks: Does NOT load the skill

evals.name: multi-turn-guided-feature
evals.state: clean; learner simulated by hand following persona-T7.md (scripts/turn.sh)
evals.prompt: quiero hacer un botón de likes con Neon para aprender bases de datos
checks: Says memory goes to .code-mentor/ (not .claude/) and asks about .gitignore before creating it
Writes the agreement with an ASCII flow marking who writes each piece
Creates the progress file following references/memory-example.md
Asks before installing anything; exact versions only
Reads the learner's code from disk before reviewing it
Shows the first problem first and does not give core code before hint 5
On 'no lo pillo', moves to hint 3 with a traced example
At each finished step: ticks the plan, adds a Log entry with a self-contained Lesson
On a mid-step stop, updates Current step
In a new session, 'seguimos' resumes from the progress file
At the end: recap, status done, Summary, final multiple-choice quiz
On a wrong quiz answer: explains and logs it under Stuck on
